section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section focuses on the findings of the present study, which examined the factor structure and psychometric properties of the BAS-2 in Iran. The study found a one-factor structure for the Persian BAS-2 in a university population of men and women. It also discussed correlations between BAS-2 scores and other variables like self-esteem, life satisfaction, and BMI, noting gender differences in these relationships. The section concludes by outlining several limitations, including the use of a university sample and self-reported BMI, and suggests directions for future research.
